fact: 20世纪初俄国旅行者的观察：1卢布约合2先令1便士、含100戈比；俄国境内一等酒店每日约6卢布且条件现代化；跨贝加尔湖至满洲路段进口美国啤酒因高关税每瓶售1卢布25戈比。

sources.title: Oliver George Ready, Through Siberia and Manchuria by Rail (Gutenberg eBook #27733)
sources.quote: The hotel I found to be first-class and up-to-date in every way, while prices were moderate (six roubles a day) and the cuisine excellent. ... While east of Lake Baikal and Manchuria all food was much dearer, while only American beer could be obtained and that at the exorbitant price of one rouble and a quarter, say half-a-crown, the bottle, which was because of excessive import duty. ... The rouble is equivalent to about two shillings and a penny. There are 100 kopeks to the rouble.

fact: 20世纪初俄国的护照与警察监管制度（1903年10月英国旅行者实地记录）：火车进入俄国前，旅客护照被海关收走签注后列车才获准通行；在华沙、莫斯科的旅馆，护照会被警察取走签注，住客须交验护照才能入住；作者了解到在俄国不仅是旅客、连所有俄国人都必须持有护照，否则连一夜住宿都无法办理，整个人口因此经常性地处于警察视线之下；其旅程账表载明在伦敦俄国领事馆办理护照签证的费用为4先令10便士。

sources.title: Oliver George Ready, Through Siberia and Manchuria by Rail（Gutenberg eBook #27733，1904年上海出版，记1903年10-11月旅程）
sources.quote: Our luggage was examined by the Customs officers, and our passports taken away, vised, and returned, before the train was allowed to proceed. ... As soon as I had been shown to my room, my passport was again demanded by a police agent, and again taken off to be vised. I subsequently learnt that everyone in Russia--not only travellers but also all Russians--must have a passport, without which it is impossible to get even a night's lodging, so that the entire population comes directly and constantly under the eye of the police. ... fact: 1909年5月4日英国下议院质询波斯局势：俄军被派往大不里士（Tabriz）；英国外相格雷确认，英国同意此行动的条件是俄军不得偏袒波斯任何一方、仅为保护外国侨民生命财产，且行动'纯属临时性质'；格雷并称俄军采取行动时大不里士已'危在旦夕'（in extremis），俄国政府已照会列强声明出兵目的；德黑兰的英俄两国代表向波斯当局提出的要求包括恢复宪政、依新选举法立即召开议会。此事显示1909年俄国仍在其高加索以南的波斯北部直接使用武力。

sources.title: Hansard, House of Commons, 4 May 1909, vol. 4, cc. 872-3, Russia and Persia（UK Parliament Historic Hansard，格雷爵士书面与口头答复）
sources.quote: Mr. O'GRADY asked the Secretary of State for Foreign Affairs, whether he was aware that mass meetings had been held in Persia to protest against the intervention of Russia in the present crisis, and to resist the military invasion by Russian troops ... Sir E. GREY ... His Majesty's Government have fully considered the effect in Persia of the step taken, which was absolutely necessary for the protection of foreign lives and property, and is of a purely temporary nature. ... When the question of sending Russian troops to Tabriz arose, His Majesty's Government stipulated as a condition of their agreement to this step, that it should not be taken in favour of either of the contending factions in Persia, but solely for the protection of the lives of foreigners. ... It should be remembered that when the Russian Government decided to take action Tabriz was in extremis. ... the demands made by the representatives of the two Powers at Teheran include the restitution of constitutional government and the immediate convocation of an assembly elected under a new electoral law.

fact: 1909年，国家杜马向国务会议提交关于海军总参谋部的法案，拟由杜马与国务会议完全控制海军总参谋部的预算与技术组织；前财政大臣、议长维特在回忆录中记下此事，作为杜马与改组后国务会议之间围绕军事机构控制权摩擦的实例。
